# ReflectIQ — Your Personal Sales Performance Tracker | Not Another CRM

> ReflectIQ is a private, on-device sales performance tracker designed primarily for independent sales representatives, account executives, and dealmakers. It enables rapid client interaction logging, win rate analytics, and on-device AI self-coaching without storing or uploading confidential deal notes to the cloud.

- Website: https://ferrisintech.github.io/reflectiq_www/
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reflectiq-sales-performance/id6803503736
- Category: Personal Sales Tracker, Sales Performance, Business Productivity
- Pricing: Free to download, optional premium subscription & lifetime access
- Privacy Model: 100% on-device local database for all client interactions and sales notes. Zero cloud databases for your confidential deal data. In-app purchases managed securely via Apple App Store & RevenueCat.

## Core Capabilities
- **Rapid Frictionless Logging**: Capture calls, meetings, pitches, and emails in a few taps with outcome, confidence level, and energy score.
- **On-Device AI Coaching & Insights**: Local neural intelligence analyzes interaction patterns, negotiation momentum, and closing friction to provide actionable coaching tips directly on the device.
- **Win Rate & Pipeline Intelligence**: Real-time metrics on won, lost, and pending deals with historical trends.
- **Confidence & Energy Tracking**: Correlate psychological readiness and confidence dips with sales performance.
- **Executive PDF Reporting**: Generate clean, shareable performance reports and audit summaries offline.
- **Privacy-Sensitive Architecture**: Designed for confidentiality because sensitive client notes never leave the user's phone.

## Target Audience
- Independent Sales Representatives & Account Executives (CRM reports to management; ReflectIQ is your personal tool)
- Independent Closers, Brokers & Agents
- High-Stakes Consultants and Advisors

## Key Differences vs Traditional CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot)
Unlike enterprise CRMs that are built for managerial oversight and require tedious manual data entry into endless forms, ReflectIQ is built directly for the individual salesperson's personal growth, self-awareness, and deal mastery — completely offline with no mandatory account creation.
